title.zh-CN: El Grande：人数没变，为什么先后和去向会改变影响力？
title.en: El Grande: Why Do Order and Destination Change the Value of the Same People?

summary.zh-CN: 比较先选权与补给、国王移动前后的部署，以及城堡迁入如何改变多人计分；结合Kramer关于更换主题的开发回顾。
summary.en: Compare access and supply, the order of deployment and King movement, and castle destinations that change multiplayer scoring, alongside Kramer’s account of finding a new theme.
